review:
A martial-arts movie on 5x4 with four animal warriors. A Legendary Frame landing on a high-paying warrior can expand it into a huge Legendary Frame Warrior, turning one premium into a big, easy-to-connect stack.

The bonuses supercharge the frames. Cinematic presentation with dojo backdrops and fluid character art, and a 10,000x max in every mode. One of Hacksaw's more straightforward recent games – good if the mechanic-heavy ones feel like too much.
